tagline: Leading branded apparel company with lifestyle brands including Tommy Bahama, Lilly Pulitzer, Johnny Was, and Southern Tide
hero_kpi_rationale: 82% of sales come from direct distribution channels (retail stores, e-commerce, and outlet locations), demonstrating a strong business model strategy and resilience against challenges in traditional retail

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net revenue of the company
kpis.description: Consolidated net revenue including direct-to-consumer and wholesale channels

kpis.name: Direct-to-consumer sales mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of net sales from direct-to-consumer distribution channels
kpis.description: 82% of consolidated sales in Fiscal 2025 came from direct-to-consumer distribution channels, including full-price retail stores, e-commerce websites, outlet locations, and Tommy Bahama restaurant operations
kpis.signal: Highly developed direct-to-consumer strategy with 82% of sales

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2022-2026) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: Oxford Industries recognizes the growing impact of digital tools and artificial intelligence in the retail and apparel industry, particularly regarding consumer expectations for personalization and transparency
evidence: The expanding use of digital platforms, data analytics, and artificial intelligence-enabled tools across the industry has raised consumer expectations for personalization, convenience, transparency, and speed
